name: recipient-line
title: Recipient line
description: Addresses a private preview to its intended recipient. Does not verify codes, persist state, or grant or revoke access. Contract: the consumer owns lifecycle timestamps and action callbacks.

meta.whenToUse: A preview was prepared for a named person or company and the screen should say so before any code is entered.
meta.notFor: Proof of identity. A recipient shown here is presentation, and it is visible to anyone holding the link.
pitfalls: This text is readable before unlocking. Use a company or first name, never an email address or anything you would not put in the invitation itself.
meta.contract: Addresses a private preview to its intended recipient. Does not verify codes, persist state, or grant or revoke access. Contract: the consumer owns lifecycle timestamps and action callbacks.

props.name: theme
props.description: Explicit theme; omitted follows the system preference.

meta.a11y: Native controls, visible focus, localized labels; lifecycle messages use polite announcements. No modal dialog is created.

docs: UI only. Read https://knock.codes/docs/recipient-line.md. Consumers own authorization.
